profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer | Full-Stack Development
profile.summary: I am a full stack software developer with over 12 years experience of application development in GIS, criminal investigation, insurance, and biotech. Most recently I have been working on the NIH’s All of Us project.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Created a full stack web application feature that enabled administrators to review user feedback and coordinate with product owners and ML engineers in order to adjust agent performance accordingly. This was done through a React frontend with Python/FastAPI backend and hosted in AWS. Developed a system for researchers to select between both pre-defined and custom AI skills to augment our analysis agent. Applied a structured approach to agentic development with Claude Code: outlining task requirements and constraints before execution, breaking work into reviewable steps, and maintaining ownership of output quality rather than treating generation as a black box.
